newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Eurowings names Air Agencies as Dutch GSA.
newsitem.headline: Eurowings names Air Agencies as Dutch GSA.

text.p: German airline, Eurowings, has appointed Air Agencies as its Dutch general sales agent for cargo, an Air Agencies spokesman said.
Eurowings operates ATR72 aircraft between Schiphol nd German cities including Cologne, Dusseldorf, Nuremburg, Dresden, Stuttgart and Hanover.
The aircraft have a capacity of between 800-1500 kg and the company will be mainly targeting the express and small airfreight shipments, he added.
Previously, Eurowings was with the Belgium gsa, General Freight Agency. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+5017
